title: Fix: Write Vitest unit tests for analytics engine (delta, leaderboard, contracts)
description: Pre-flight CI gate FAILED: `npm test` exits code 1 because no test files exist matching vitest.config.ts patterns (src/**/*.test.ts | tests/**/*.test.ts). Write comprehensive unit tests for the analytics engine without hitting SQLite — use in-memory mocking/vi.mock. Tests must cover: (1) negative delta clamping to 0, (2) missing previous snapshot returns 0 delta, (3) leaderboard sort orders, (4) top gainer tracks ranking, (5) branded type constructors. Use vitest globals (describe/it/expect/vi) — no imports needed as globals:true is set.
acceptance_criteria: npm test exits with code 0 (vitest run finds and passes all test files)
delta.test.ts: test negative clamp -> Math.max(0, negative) = 0
delta.test.ts: test missing previous snapshot -> dailyStreams = 0, previousPlaycount = currentPlaycount
leaderboard.test.ts: test sort by totalDailyStreams desc ordering
aggregator.test.ts: test artist aggregate sums track deltas correctly
All DB calls are mocked via vi.mock('@/lib/db/client')
No imports of vitest globals needed (globals:true in config)
TypeScript strict mode compatible — no type errors
